hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$cmd" in *'gh pr create'*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; files=$(git diff main...HEAD --name-only 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; if printf '%s\n' "$files" | grep -qx 'docs/build-log.md'; then exit 0; fi; if [ -n "$files" ] && ! printf '%s\n' "$files" | grep -qv '^docs/'; then exit 0; fi; echo 'build-log guard: this branch does not update docs/build-log.md. Add an entry for this PR (see CLAUDE.md workflow), commit it, then re-run gh pr create.' >&2; exit 2
